content.short: Pyth Network connects high-fidelity market data from professional trading firms and exchanges directly to smart contracts on Mantle with sub-second updates.
content.description: Pyth Network is a first-party oracle network that sources price data directly from institutional market participants including trading firms, market makers, and exchanges  providing extremely high-quality, low-latency price feeds with sub-second update frequencies far more responsive than traditional oracle models. Pyth's pull-based oracle model lets applications request the latest price only when needed, dramatically reducing gas costs. Deployed on Mantle, Pyth provides institutional-grade data quality for the network's DeFi protocols.
content.meta: Pyth Network provides high-fidelity, low-latency institutional price data to smart contracts on Mantle. Discover Pyth on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
